business_meaning: Identifier of an order placed on ShopFast (one row per order, 7 raw duplicates removed)
Customer account that placed the order (key to stg_customers)
allowed_values_or_range: 10001 to 20962; 14 orders point to an unknown customer

business_meaning: Date the order was placed by the customer
allowed_values_or_range: 2025-01-01 to 2027-03-13 (5 orders in the future = data issue)

business_meaning: Where the order is in its lifecycle
Sales channel where the order was placed
Country where the order is delivered
Total paid by the customer for the order, VAT and shipping fee (4.99 under 50 EUR) included, before refunds
allowed_values_or_range: -49.90 to 1400.79; should be > 0 (6 orders <= 0 = data issue)

business_meaning: Identifier of one payment event at the payment provider
Order paid or refunded by this event (key to stg_orders)
Date the money was captured or refunded
Payment method chosen by the customer
Amount of money captured or refunded by this event; always positive, the direction is in payment_status
unit_or_format: EUROS with 2 decimals (54.50 = 54 euros 50), NOT cents

business_meaning: Last 4 digits of the bank card used (payment data linked to a person via order_id)
allowed_values_or_range: 0000 to 9999; should be empty when method <> card (1469 rows filled for non-card, 1059 card rows empty)

business_meaning: Type of payment event: money received or money sent back
